question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Morbid compulsion to consume alcohol continuously
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The term **"Morbid compulsion to consume alcohol continuously"** refers to an uncontrollable and pathological urge to drink alcohol frequently. (लगातार शराब पीने की विकृत प्रवृत्ति) • **Example:** Despite numerous attempts to quit, his** dipsomania** led him to relapse repeatedly. • **"Dipsomania"** is the medical term for this condition, characterized by an insatiable craving for alcohol. (मद्यपान की उन्मत्त इच्छा) • **Example:** The patient was diagnosed with **dipsomania** and was advised to seek immediate treatment. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Satyromania** (व्यभिचार की उन्मत्त इच्छा): An excessive, uncontrollable sexual desire in men. • **Example:** His satyromania caused numerous problems in his personal relationships. • **Maniac** (उन्मादी): A person exhibiting extreme symptoms of wild behavior, especially when violent and dangerous. • **Example:** The maniac was apprehended by the police after causing chaos in the neighborhood. • **Kleptomania** (चोरी करने की आदत): A recurrent urge to steal, typically without regard for need or profit. • **Example:** Her kleptomania led her to shoplift items she didn't even need. 36:Tb91, The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
